div.p: Find answers to common inquiries regarding bank internal services and IT operations.

h2.button: How do I report a system outage?

div.div: Please contact the IT Helpdesk immediately via your internal dashboard or by calling the extension 9030. Provide your terminal ID and a screenshot of the error.

h2.button: When will the Odoo 19 migration be complete?

div.div: The migration is currently in the validation phase. We expect full implementation by the end of Q3 2026. Updates will be posted on the portal homepage.

h2.button: How do I access my payroll documents?

div.div: Payroll slips are available through the "Employee Services" dropdown in the main navigation menu under the dedicated HR portal link.

                        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                            // Smart Button (3 lines) Icon-Only Sidebar Toggle
                            var sidebarBtn = document.getElementById('sidebarToggle');
                            if (sidebarBtn) {
                                sidebarBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                                    e.preventDefault();
                                    document.body.classList.toggle('sidebar-collapsed');
                                });
                            }

                            // Settings Sub-menu Accordion Toggle
                            var settingsToggle = document.getElementById('settingsToggle');
                            var settingsSubmenu = document.getElementById('settingsSubmenu');
                            var settingsChevron = document.getElementById('settingsChevron');
                            if (settingsToggle && settingsSubmenu) {
                                settingsToggle.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                                    e.preventDefault();
                                    if (settingsSubmenu.style.display === 'none' || settingsSubmenu.style.display === '') {
                                        settingsSubmenu.style.display = 'block';
                                        if (settingsChevron) settingsChevron.className = 'fa fa-chevron-down nav-arrow';
                                    } else {
                                        settingsSubmenu.style.display = 'none';
                                        if (settingsChevron) settingsChevron.className = 'fa fa-chevron-right nav-arrow';
                                    }
                                });
                            }
                            // Force page reload from server if navigated back via browser Back button after logout
                            window.addEventListener('pageshow', function (event) {
                                if (event.persisted || (window.performance && window.performance.getEntriesByType("navigation")[0] && window.performance.getEntriesByType("navigation")[0].type === "back_forward")) {
                                    window.location.reload();
                                }
                            });
                        });
